title: “Blame It on the Rain” by Milli Vanilli
text: "Blame It on the Rain" is a song written by Diane Warren and performed by the German dance-pop group Milli Vanilli. It was released as a new track from the group's North American debut album, Girl You Know It's True, and did not appear on All or Nothing (1988), their debut album in other regions.

title: “Listen to Your Heart” by Roxette
text: "Listen to Your Heart" is a song by Swedish rock duo Roxette, originally released in Sweden in September 1988 by Parlophone and EMI as the second single from the duo's second studio album, Look Sharp!.

title: “I'll Be There for You” by Bon Jovi
text: "I'll Be There for You" is a song by American rock band Bon Jovi, released as the third single from their 1988 album, New Jersey. The power ballad was written by Jon Bon Jovi and Richie Sambora.

title: “If You Don't Know Me by Now” by Simply Red
text: "If You Don't Know Me by Now" is a song written by Kenny Gamble and Leon Huff, and recorded by the Philadelphia soul musical group Harold Melvin & the Blue Notes. It became their first hit after being released as a single in September 1972, topping the US R&B chart and peaking at number 3 on the US Billboard Hot 100.

title: “Like a Prayer” by Madonna
text: "Like a Prayer" is a song by American singer Madonna from her fourth studio album, Like a Prayer. It was released as the album's lead single on March 3, 1989, by Sire Records.

title: “I'll Be Loving You (Forever)” by New Kids on the Block
text: "I'll Be Loving You" is a song by American boy band New Kids on the Block, released in April 1989 by Columbia Records as the third single from the group's second album, Hangin' Tough (1988). The song is both written and produced by Maurice Starr, and lead vocals are sung by Jordan Knight.

title: “How Can I Fall?” by Breathe
text: "How Can I Fall?" is a song by British band Breathe, written by the group members David Glasper and Marcus Lillington. It was released in June 1988 as the second single from their debut studio album, All That Jazz.

title: “Baby Don't Forget My Number” by Milli Vanilli
text: "Baby Don't Forget My Number" is a song by German dance-pop group Milli Vanilli. The track was released in December 1988 as the second single from their debut album, All or Nothing, as well as its American counterpart, Girl You Know It's True (1989).
